fail.quote: Pass when the final runs demonstrate a reproducible reduction beyond measurement noise in LCP and time to a usable primary call to action
fail.reason: T11 requires a stretch, but the prompt selects no hard target. It has no task-specific 'aim for' target, no instruction to try the next approach before reporting a miss, and no separate met/missed stretch report. The only bar is any reduction beyond noise.

fail.quote: Use browser performance traces, network waterfalls, and screenshots to measure Largest Contentful Paint (LCP)
fail.reason: Names raw traces and waterfalls but no instruments by name, such as a lab tool like Lighthouse or WebPageTest. It has no real-user or field measurement (RUM, CrUX) and does not mention the JavaScript bundle. 'Available browser/profiling tools' is generic.
Missing a hard numeric target on a named metric written as 'aim for'. The prompt never states a number for LCP or any other metric.
